R7BB-bear-walk-0004.name: By Windy Creek
R7BB-bear-walk-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BB-bear-walk-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), 170 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2016 (fire G70045), 490 m S: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Windy Creek 30 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-05): get permission first or go around.
Private land 20 m W: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 57 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.99529, -121.32628, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 890 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 8 m, about 18 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-32, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
